mapper.select: SELECT agg.link_id AS link_id, agg.pv AS pv, agg.uv AS uv, c.code AS code, c.original_url AS original_url, c.deleted AS deleted FROM ( SELECT s.link_id AS link_id, SUM(s.pv) AS pv, SUM(s.uv) AS uv FROM link_stats_daily s WHERE s.tenant_id = #{param1} AND s.day >= #{param2} AND s.day <= #{param3} GROUP BY s.link_id ORDER BY pv DESC, uv DESC, s.link_id ASC LIMIT #{param4} ) agg LEFT JOIN analytics_link_catalog c ON c.tenant_id = #{param1} AND c.link_id = agg.link_id ORDER BY agg.pv DESC, agg.uv DESC, agg.link_id ASC
